title: Issue 141 retained audio mapping full review
scope: Read-only comparison of the exact retained full Matrix and Media Pool pair; no Resolve calls and no media files opened, read, or hashed.

linkedAudioOffsetObservation.result: No retained mapping contained a nonempty linked_audio object, so linked-audio sample offsets were not exercised by this capture.

supported: The documented source-channel mapping getter returned a native value for all 132 Matrix timeline items on each of two passes.
The documented MediaPoolItem audio-mapping getter returned a native value for 7 of 13 retained pool entries on each pass; the other 6 entries had no mapping field in the retained readback.
Matrix item identity, source binding, track location, mapping status, and parsed mapping value were stable across both passes; pool identity and mapping readback were also stable.
Captured mapping values expose embedded channel count, track_mapping channel indices/type, and the captured mute field for these items.
limits: The 6 pool entries without GetAudioMapping are timeline assets in the retained pool inventory; this review does not turn that absence into an unsupported-capability claim.
Source-channel mapping does not establish Fairlight track mute/solo, bus routing, program audibility, or rendered output.
An empty linked_audio object is an observation of this capture, not evidence that linked-audio offsets cannot be represented.
No lineage, speech deletion, or asset-deletion claim is made.
